title: Gorse the Brave Bridge-Tester
markdown:
Dawn burst over Craggy Peak! Brilliant colors painted the sky, and the air hummed with the promise of the Great Harvest Fair. But Gorse the goat had a secret fear: wobbly bridges! Every day, he’d dash across the plank bridge to the village for shiny pebbles, but his legs always trembled.

Until one day, a fierce storm struck! *CRACK!* The bridge snapped in two! Gorse stared. The village was cut off. The fair was ruined!

Gorse’s heart thumped a wild rhythm. What could he do? Then, he remembered Maple, the brilliant mole engineer! Gorse zoomed down the muddy path and found her tinkering. "Maple!" he panted. "The bridge is broken! The fair is ruined!"

Maple adjusted her spectacles. "A broken bridge? A catastrophe! But not impossible!" She unrolled a giant blueprint. "We need strong wood and super ropes! And one brave tester!"

Gorse gulped. Testing meant wobbly bridges. But for the fair, for his friends! "I can help!" Gorse blurted out.

Maple beamed. "Fantastic! Your springy legs will be perfect! You’ll be our chief plank-tester!"

Work began! Maple’s team hammered and tied. Gorse watched, hooves tapping nervously. Then, it was his turn. Maple held out a fresh plank. "Give it a go, Gorse! Be brave!"

Gorse took a shaky breath. He pictured apple pies and bouncy castles. He put one hoof down. *Wobble.* The plank creaked! A shiver shot through him. He almost bolted! But he saw Maple’s determined face and the villagers’ hopeful eyes. "You can do it, Gorse!" they cheered.

With a mighty push, Gorse sprang forward. *Bounce!* His hooves landed! The plank held! He did it again. And again. Each plank he tested, his fear shrank. His hooves felt steadier. His heart beat faster—an excited, adventurous beat! He was a bridge-tester!

Finally, the last plank lay before him. It looked the wobbliest. The wind tugged at it. Gorse took a brave breath. His hooves pounded the wood with a *thump-thump-thump!* The wind whipped past his ears, a wild song. He took one giant, springy leap! *WHOOSH!* He landed firmly. The plank held! He'd done it!

"It's safe," Gorse yelled, his voice booming. "The bridge is ready for the fair!"

The villagers cheered! Maple patted his back. "You were brilliant, Gorse! Truly brave! You saved the fair!"

Ever since then, Gorse was known for his courage. He still loved his sturdy bridge, but he knew now that even the wobbliest crossings could be conquered. The adventure was just beginning, and Gorse, the brave bridge-tester, was ready for anything!
characters: Gorse the goat, Maple the mole engineer
